list.title: My teams
list.subtitle: The ones you created, and the ones you were given a seat in.
list.caption: List of my teams
list.emptyDescription: Create one: players are added by their Riot ID, without waiting for all five to sign in.
list.claimHelper: If someone added you by your Riot ID before you linked your Riot account, this button attaches those seats to your account.
list.claimNone: No seat was waiting for you.

create.title: New team
create.description: A name is enough to start. The roster comes next, player by player.
create.proposed: The team will be created with: {{players}}.

rename.title: Rename the team
rename.description: The name is what other members see; changing your mind costs nothing.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.description: The roster and the saved compositions go with it. This cannot be undone.

roster.title: The roster
roster.description: A member is identified by their Riot ID. If they already have a {{product}} account, the seat is attached at once; otherwise it waits for them, and they will claim it by linking their Riot account.
roster.caption: The team members
roster.emptyDescription: Add your players by their Riot ID — yours included, if you play.
roster.linkedHelp: This Riot ID matches a {{product}} account.
roster.freeHelp: Nobody has claimed this seat yet.

add.title: Add a member
add.description: Search for the player's Riot account, then pick it from the list. If they already have a {{product}} account, the slot is attached to it right away.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.description: The Riot ID and the linked account are not editable here: the first belongs to Riot, the second is earned by claiming.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from the roster?
remove.description: The seat disappears. Compositions that named it will lose this player.

fields.rolesHelper: Several positions are allowed. The first one is the usual position — it is what orders the roster. Leave empty if the position is not decided yet.
fields.coachHasNoRole: A non-playing coach holds no position: positions are cleared.
fields.statusHelper: Coach combines with Starter or Substitute. Coach alone: does not play.

draft.title: Prepared compositions
draft.description: Drafts, to show the team: one champion and one player per position, substitutes, and the planned bans. No pick order, no timer — this is not a draft simulator.
draft.emptyDescription: Prepare one: all five positions are there, even if the roster is not.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.description: The draft disappears. Nothing else depends on it.

fields.name: Composition name
fields.patchHelper: The version at the time of preparation, prefilled with the catalogue's. A composition reread in three months without its version speaks of champions that have changed.
fields.notesHelper: What the composition is trying to do. Optional.
fields.playerTaken: {{name}} — already at {{role}}; a click brings them here
fields.bansHelper: A banned champion can no longer be picked, neither as a starter nor as a substitute.
fields.catalogMissing: The champion catalogue could not be loaded: no champion can be chosen for now.

validation.championRequired: Every position carries a champion: that is what makes a composition.

advice.combosEmpty: No game played as a pair in this period yet.
advice.combosMethod: Over {{games}} games played by two members or more. Ranked by the lower bound of the win rate (Wilson): a 3/3 does not beat a 15/20. Confidence from {{duo}} games for a duo, {{trio}} for a trio. The "in general" reference covers every collected game, all players and tiers.
advice.toTryMethod: Duos that win in general (at least 30 collected games, more than one win in two), with champions from the team pool or played at least 5 times by the player, that you played together fewer than 3 times.
advice.bansConclusion: {{champion}}: {{wins}} W – {{losses}} L in {{count}} games against them.
advice.bansEmpty: No champion is clearly a problem for you in this period.
advice.banLine: {{wins}} W – {{losses}} L against them · met in {{count}} of your {{games}} games
advice.laneThreat: Against {{champion}}, {{player}} loses {{gold}} gold at 15 min on average ({{count}} games).
advice.bansMethod: Ranked by impact: presence × win rate loss against your average, the loss taken at its cautious bound. A champion met fewer than {{duo}} times comes after the others. Over {{games}} games.
advice.lateWins: Wins mostly in long games: its wins last {{wins}} min on average, its losses {{losses}} min.
advice.earlyWins: Wins mostly fast: its wins last {{wins}} min on average, its losses {{losses}} min.
advice.compositionMethod: A game counts when the five champions, or their substitutes, are on our side, whoever played them.

notFound.title: Team not found
notFound.description: This team does not exist, or its members have not made it public.

month.title: Form of the month
month.none: No game together in the last 30 days.

share.title: Public page
share.toggleHelper: A read-only page anyone can see and search engines index. Each member can hide their name on it.
share.hideMe: Hide my name on the public page

training.title: Training nights
training.none: No slot: every session stays free.
training.helper: Paris time. Every night, PremadeLab spots your sessions: at least three members, two games in a row, no break longer than an hour. A session overlapping a slot is a training session; a slot without a game counts as missed.
